title: Select and delete failure artifacts
summary: Changed Reports failure cleanup so operators select one or more artifact rows and click Delete selected artifacts without visible preview buttons or typed confirmation text. Active error clear and evidence archive actions also use direct confirm buttons while preserving backend-owned confirmations and fingerprints internally where required.
reason: The Reports cleanup UI exposed preview-first workflows and confirmation text that made routine deletion of failure artifacts, notices, and active errors harder than necessary.
behavior_before: Failure artifact cleanup required a visible preview button, reason text, and confirmation text before deletion. Active error clear and evidence archive controls also exposed preview-first flows in the Reports UI.
behavior_after: Failure artifact cleanup renders selectable artifact rows with a select-all checkbox and a Delete selected artifacts button. Reports sends checked artifact_paths to the backend, runs required dry-run/fingerprint checks internally, and then posts confirmed delete payloads. Error clear and evidence archive controls no longer expose preview buttons; archive still performs the backend dry-run internally before confirming.
tests_added: Updated failure artifact cleanup service tests for selected artifact planning and deletion.
Updated Local API, command payload, static Reports, browser smoke, and mutation-boundary tests for select-and-delete behavior.
rollback_plan: Revert the Reports failure cleanup UI/command changes, selected artifact backend payload support, contract/inventory updates, regenerated WebView baselines, generated summaries, and related tests from this packet.
